watch.label: Watch
watch.desc: Everything running right now and what needs you, on one board.

tasks.label: Tasks
tasks.desc: Every task with its progress, report and review.

issues.label: Issues
issues.desc: Track issues and open pull requests from GitHub repositories.

meetings.label: Meetings
meetings.desc: The lead asks several members in rounds: private answers, then an anonymous cross-check with verified evidence, a decision and minutes.

contests.label: Contests
contests.desc: One brief, several attempts in parallel, each in its own worktree. A machine scores them, a judge compares them blind, and you pick the winner to apply to your working folder.

automations.label: Automations
automations.desc: Work handed to workers on a schedule. It runs only when the pre-check command allows it and there is enough quota.

proof.label: Proof
proof.desc: Which requirements a gate command proves and which it does not. Re-run every gate to catch regressions.

accounts.label: Accounts
accounts.desc: The accounts and API keys workers use to run jobs.

usage.label: Usage
usage.desc: Tokens, cost and limits over time, by project and by account.

roles.label: Roles
roles.desc: Define skills, required rules, report style and skill sets for workers.

members.label: Members
members.desc: Who in the department takes work, with which worker source and model.
